```{r}

#############################################################################################################

# Replication timing profiling of hPu-hPy repeat-associated regions
# - Imports whole-genome and hPu-hPy-associated genomic coordinates
# - Loads Repli-seq BigWig tracks from four S-phase fractions (S1-S4)
# - Quantifies replication timing signal across each genomic interval
# - Calculates Early and Late replication scores from Repli-seq data
# - Computes replication timing as log2(Early/Late)
# - Compares replication timing between genome-wide regions and hPu-hPy-associated loci
# - Distinguishes hPu and hPy repeats according to replication fork orientation (POS/NEG)
# - Summarizes replication timing distributions using median values
# - Generates boxplots with P10-P90 whiskers and median annotations
# - save the figure
#
# Requirements:
#   - GenomicRanges
#   - IRanges
#   - rtracklayer
#   - dplyr
#   - ggplot2

#############################################################################################################

# Packages installation CRAN + BIOCONDUCTOR
cran_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
)

bioc_pkgs <- c(
  "GenomicRanges",
  "rtracklayer"
)

# Utility function: install only missing CRAN packages
install_missing_cran <- function(pkgs) {
  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    install.packages(
      missing,
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
}

# Utility function: install only missing Bioconductor packages
install_missing_bioc <- function(pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(
      "BiocManager",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }

  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    BiocManager::install(
      missing,
      ask = FALSE,
      update = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Install missing packages
install_missing_cran(cran_pkgs)
install_missing_bioc(bioc_pkgs)

message("All required packages are installed.")

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)

#############################################################################################################

# Function to calculate the replication timing for a bed file
analyse_RT <- function(bed_file, nom_dataset){
  cat("Analyse :", nom_dataset, "\n")
  rep <- read.table(
    bed_file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  colnames(rep)[1:4] <- c(
    "chr",
    "start",
    "end",
    "motif"
  )
  rep_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = rep$chr,
    ranges = IRanges(
      start = rep$start + 1,
      end = rep$end
    )
  )
  fractions <- c("S1","S2","S3","S4")
  for(f in fractions){
    message("  Import ", f)
    bw <- import(
      file.path(
        "/repliseq/bw/file/path",
        paste0(
          "cellline_name",
          f,
          "PctSignalRep1.bigWig"
        )
      )
    )

    ov <- findOverlaps(rep_gr, bw)
    moy <- tapply(
      score(bw)[subjectHits(ov)],
      queryHits(ov),
      mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    signal <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(rep_gr)
    )
    signal[as.numeric(names(moy))] <- moy

    mcols(rep_gr)[[f]] <- signal
  }

  df <- as.data.frame(rep_gr)

  df$Early <- df$S1 + df$S2
  df$Late  <- df$S3 + df$S4

  df$RT_log2 <- log2(
    (df$Early + 0.01) /
    (df$Late + 0.01)
  )

  df$condition <- nom_dataset

  df <- subset(
    df,
    !is.na(RT_log2)
  )

  return(df)
}

# Analysis of the bed with Okseq results (pos/neg) overlapped with hpu-hpy regions

# Whole genome 
rt_whole <- analyse_RT("/hg19_hDNA_repeats/bed/file/path",
                       "Genome-wide")

rt_hPu_neg <- analyse_RT(
  "/path/to/hpu/neg/bed/file",
  "hPu_NEG"
)

rt_hPy_neg <- analyse_RT(
  "/path/to/hpy/neg/bed/file",
  "hPy_NEG"
)

rt_hPu_pos <- analyse_RT(
  "/path/to/hpu/pos/bed/file",
  "hPu_POS"
)

rt_hPy_pos <- analyse_RT(
  "/path/to/hpy/pos/bed/file",
  "hPy_POS"
)

# Fusion of all the files
all_df <- rbind(
  rt_hPu_neg,
  rt_hPy_neg,
  rt_hPu_pos,
  rt_hPy_pos,
  rt_whole
)

table(all_df$condition)

# RT median per condition
res <- aggregate(
  RT_log2 ~ condition,
  data = all_df,
  median,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

res <- res[order(res$RT_log2), ]

# Boxplot
# Group order

all_df$condition <- factor(
  all_df$condition,
  levels = c(
    "Genome-wide",
    "hPy_POS",
    "hPu_POS",
    "hPy_NEG",
    "hPu_NEG"
  )
)

# Colors
contour_colors <- c(
  "hPu_NEG" = "springgreen4",
  "hPy_NEG" = "firebrick",
  "hPu_POS" = "springgreen4",
  "hPy_POS" = "firebrick",
  "Genome-wide" = "black"
)

# Boxplot with P10-P90
q_box <- function(y) {
  data.frame(
    ymin   = quantile(y, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower  = quantile(y, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    middle = quantile(y, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper  = quantile(y, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymax   = quantile(y, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# Medians
stats_df <- all_df %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    median_RT = median(RT_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
p_RT <- ggplot(all_df,aes(x = condition,y = RT_log2,color = condition)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = q_box,geom = "boxplot",width = 0.9,size = 0.6,fill = "white") +
  geom_text(data = stats_df,aes( x = condition,y = median_RT, label = paste0("Median: ",round(median_RT, 2))),inherit.aes = FALSE,size = 3,color = "black",vjust = -0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = contour_colors) +
  labs(x = "",y = "RT score [log2(Early/Late)]") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_RT)

# Save the plot
ggsave(filename = "/output/plot/path",plot = p_RT,width = 7,height = 3,units = "in")

#############################################################################################################

```
